# MikroTik PCC Load Balancing Premium Configuration # Generated by Keripik Kinta # RouterOS: v7 # ISPs: 2 # Recursive: on # Bandwidth Ratio: on # Local Address Lists /ip firewall address-list add address=10.0.0.0/8 list=LOKAL /ip firewall address-list add address=172.16.0.0/12 list=LOKAL /ip firewall address-list add address=192.168.0.0/16 list=LOKAL # Default Routes /ip route add check-gateway=ping comment="Default Route via isp1" distance=1 gateway=1.1.1.1 target-scope=30 /ip route add check-gateway=ping comment="Default Route via isp2" distance=2 gateway=1.1.1.2 target-scope=30 # Routing Mark Routes /ip route add check-gateway=ping comment="Routing Mark for isp1" distance=1 gateway=1.1.1.1 routing-table="isp1" target-scope=30 /ip route add check-gateway=ping comment="Routing Mark for isp2" distance=1 gateway=1.1.1.2 routing-table="isp2" target-scope=30 # Mangle Rules - Local Traffic Bypass /ip firewall mangle add action=accept chain=prerouting comment="PCC Load Balancing by Keripik Kinta @Pejuang GSM – v5.0 – 2025" dst-address-list=LOKAL src-address-list=LOKAL /ip firewall mangle add action=accept chain=postrouting dst-address-list=LOKAL src-address-list=LOKAL /ip firewall mangle add action=accept chain=forward dst-address-list=LOKAL src-address-list=LOKAL /ip firewall mangle add action=accept chain=input dst-address-list=LOKAL src-address-list=LOKAL /ip firewall mangle add action=accept chain=output dst-address-list=LOKAL src-address-list=LOKAL /ip firewall mangle add action=accept chain=prerouting hotspot=http # Input Connection Marking /ip firewall mangle add action=mark-connection chain=input in-interface="isp1" new-connection-mark="isp1" passthrough=yes /ip firewall mangle add action=mark-connection chain=input in-interface="isp2" new-connection-mark="isp2" passthrough=yes # Output Routing Marking /ip firewall mangle add action=mark-routing chain=output connection-mark="isp1" new-routing-mark="isp1" passthrough=yes /ip firewall mangle add action=mark-routing chain=output connection-mark="isp2" new-routing-mark="isp2" passthrough=yes # PCC Load Balancing Rules /ip firewall mangle add action=mark-connection chain=prerouting dst-address-type=!local new-connection-mark="isp1" passthrough=yes per-connection-classifier=both-addresses-and-ports:4/0 dst-address-list=!LOKAL src-address-list=LOKAL /ip firewall mangle add action=mark-connection chain=prerouting dst-address-type=!local new-connection-mark="isp2" passthrough=yes per-connection-classifier=both-addresses-and-ports:4/1 dst-address-list=!LOKAL src-address-list=LOKAL /ip firewall mangle add action=mark-connection chain=prerouting dst-address-type=!local new-connection-mark="isp2" passthrough=yes per-connection-classifier=both-addresses-and-ports:4/2 dst-address-list=!LOKAL src-address-list=LOKAL /ip firewall mangle add action=mark-connection chain=prerouting dst-address-type=!local new-connection-mark="isp2" passthrough=yes per-connection-classifier=both-addresses-and-ports:4/3 dst-address-list=!LOKAL src-address-list=LOKAL # Final Routing Marking /ip firewall mangle add action=mark-routing chain=prerouting connection-mark="isp1" new-routing-mark="isp1" passthrough=yes dst-address-list=!LOKAL src-address-list=LOKAL /ip firewall mangle add action=mark-routing chain=prerouting connection-mark="isp2" new-routing-mark="isp2" passthrough=yes dst-address-list=!LOKAL src-address-list=LOKAL #
